summary: SIEM feed s055_single is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10, 20 are completely missing. All other checks (duplicates, encryption, one-way, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or upstream TAP/SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags before delivery. 100% untagged with 0% of required VLANs 10, 20 observed indicates the ingress trunk is not passed through or the broker egress is set to access/untagged mode or VLAN stripping is enabled.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM loses VLAN/segment context for VLANs 10 and 20. Cannot filter, correlate, or attribute events by tenant/zone, reducing detection coverage and breaking VLAN-based use cases and compliance reporting, even though SIEM does not require full payload or bidirectional flow.

recommended_fix.why: Preserving/restoring 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 on the broker egress to the SIEM restores segment visibility so the SIEM can correctly classify and detect on those VLANs.
